_about: How the office is lit: by the real sun over Bucharest, computed for the real date and hour (hq_time.js), with the real weather the backend reads (/api/v1/office/weather) raining, snowing, fogging and clouding over it. The Owner ruled on 2026-09-18/19 that the sky follows the real outside conditions and is never held at dusk, so there is no other mode.
_about_live_stream: The Unreal headquarters streamed into the page (Pixel Streaming 2), shown whenever the backend has STUDIO_OFFICE_STREAM_SIGNALLING_URL and the stream runs (art-source/unreal/live/start_live_hq.ps1). Otherwise the page shows its own renderer.
